steps.en: Install or fetch the server — Python alone is enough
steps.zh: 安装或直接拿走那个单文件脚本，只需要 Python
steps.code: python3 -m pip install --user -U copyparty · uv tool run copyparty

steps.en: Point it at a folder and define who may write
steps.zh: 指向一个目录，定义谁能读写

steps.en: Serves it over HTTP, WebDAV, FTP(S), SFTP, TFTP and SMB with a browser UI
steps.zh: 以 HTTP 及 WebDAV/FTP/SFTP 等多协议对外服务

steps.en: Enable indexing and dedup, then drag files into the browser to upload
steps.zh: 开启索引与去重，再把文件拖进浏览器上传

steps.en: up2k splits uploads into blocks, resumes dropped transfers, and stores duplicate bytes once
steps.zh: up2k 把上传切块、断线可续传，重复内容只存一份

value.en: A durable, searchable file server in one Python script — no database, no stack to babysit
value.zh: 一个 Python 脚本就是耐用、可搜索的文件服务器——没有数据库，也没有要伺候的栈

sources: README.md 9001/copyparty @ hovudstraum (retrieved 2026-09-28) quickstart: 'python3 -m pip install --user -U copyparty'; 'uv tool run copyparty'; example flag '-v /mnt/music:/music:r:rw,foo -a foo:bar'; '-e2dsa enables general file indexing'
README.md 'the browser / uploading': 'drag files/folders into the web-browser to upload'; features list: 'up2k: js, resumable, multithreaded'
README.md 'file deduplication': 'enable symlink-based upload deduplication globally with --dedup'; protocol list: 'http(s) // webdav // sftp // ftp(s) // tftp // smb/cifs'
